title: Real-content fit at 4096: does the encoder signal exist in real files at all? 0014's searched model M4, 0003's incumbent M1 and 0014's standardised logistic L3, each fitted once on the 26346 rows of a real-content corpus built from the chunks of 0018's pinned files its sealed evaluation corpus does not use, and scored once on 0018's scoring set. One clause: M4's correct rows over the 38452 rows of the five real-file families against chance + 0.05. A builder-matched fit at the same row budget, the two other recipes, the synthetic families and the reverse reading on the builder's evaluation set are flags.

scope.one_line: One fit corpus (real content only: every whole 32768-byte chunk of 0018's five pinned real blobs that its sealed selection does not use, minus every chunk byte-identical to a sealed chunk or to an earlier fit chunk - 1035 chunks, 26346 rows, sealed by array hash below), one seed (20260825), three recipes (0003's M1, 0014's L3 and M4, 0018's roster entries verbatim), one scoring set (0018's: the sealed 260000-row evaluation set plus the whole 61409-row extension corpus), six fits, one scoring each.
scope.why_this_is_the_question_the_record_left: 0018/0019 read OOB_TRANSFER_FAILS: M4 fitted on the builder's eight generated families identifies the encoder on the five real-file families at 0.0637 (2450 of 38452 rows) against 3402 needed, and VERDICT.md says in as many words that the record 'says nothing about what a recipe fitted on real content would do'. Two worlds are consistent with that reading: the builder's families teach the wrong thing (a training-distribution failure), or real content carries little encoder signal at this carve (a content failure). They differ in what the next year of work would be, and nothing banked separates them. This run separates them by changing exactly one thing - what the model is fitted on - and holding the scoring set, the recipes, the seed, the bar and the machinery fixed.
scope.what_this_is_and_is_not: This is an IN-DISTRIBUTION reading on real content, not a transfer reading. The fit chunks and the scored chunks are cut from the same five pinned blobs; they share no byte, no chunk index, no chunk id and no source-chunk hash (proved by `python3 tools/pivot/corpus_realfit.py --disjoint` and measured again by the runner, which also digests every scored feature row and requires that no fit row is byte-identical to one), but they are the same files. A pass says the signal is there when the model has seen content of that kind; it does not say the model would find it on a real file kind it has never seen. A fail at this budget says the signal is not reachable by this recipe from 26346 rows of this content, which is a bound on the recipe and the budget together, not on real content forever.

corpus_fit.built_by: tools/pivot/corpus_realfit.py (imports the label factory from tools/pivot/corpus_ext.py, which imports it from tools/pivot/corpus.py: the same 26 configurations, the same 32768-byte chunks, the same mid-stream 4096-byte carve, the same 1108 features)
corpus_fit.imbalance_stated_in_advance: the fit corpus is what the pinned blobs leave over, so it is imbalanced by construction: py_src 17197 rows (0.6527 of the fit rows), pe_bin 5145, rfc_txt 2340, rst_doc 1040, c_src 624. The evaluation set is balanced (about 7400 to 7800 rows per family), so the per-family readings are banked beside the clause and a fail on a family with few fit rows is not read as a fail on that family's content.

corpus_scored.what: 0018's scoring set, row for row: the sealed 260000-row evaluation set of the builder's eight families (the reverse reading) and the whole 61409-row extension corpus (the clause is over its five real families, 38452 rows; the three synthetic families are a flag)
corpus_scored.already_scored_by: 0018, whose banked readings for the same rows under a builder-fitted M4 are the comparison

scope.seed: 20260825 throughout, as in 0003 and 0014-0019: the grouped split, the pool order, the fit corpus's row permutation and the null-label shuffle all come from it. The fit corpus's chunk selection has no seed of its own - it is the complement of 0018's sealed selection, in blob order.
scope.design: Six fits in the sealed order, each scored exactly once on the concatenated scoring set, with the per-example correctness vector banked in full so the reader recomputes every reading: (1) repro, 0003's incumbent on the pool's first 100000 rows, which must reproduce 0003's banked 0.1965 on the sealed evaluation set - the rung 0016 reproduced in this environment; (2) null, M4 on the fit corpus with its labels permuted, which must sit at chance on both row sets; (3) real_model, M4 on the whole fit corpus - the clause; (4) real_incumbent and (5) real_logistic, the other two recipes on the same rows; (6) builder_matched, M4 on the pool's first 26346 rows, the same budget on the builder's content, so a fail cannot be read as a volume effect without also explaining that arm.
scope.what_this_measures_and_does_not: Measures: whether three fixed recipes, fitted on real content at this budget, identify the encoder on held-out chunks of the same real files at chance + 0.05, and how that compares with the same recipe fitted on the builder's content at the same budget and at 800000 rows (0018, banked). Does not measure: transfer to real content of a kind not in the fit corpus; any carve size other than 4096; any recipe off 0014's roster; what a recipe searched on real content would do (the search is a different preregistration); or anything about a buyer.
scope.cost: EXTRAPOLATION from banked fits: the six fits are small - 0018's null (M4 on 20000 rows) took 83.7 s and 0003's 100000-row rung 203.6 s - so the run is dominated by six scorings of 321409 rows and the row-identity scan over every scored row. Expected well under an hour of fit time at 3 threads and nice 10 on 4 cores, no GPU. The runner refuses under 8.0 GB MemAvailable, under 0.5 GB free disk, beside any other tools/pivot runner, above a 1-minute load of 2.0, and on any sealed-hash or environment mismatch; the memory kill threshold is 13.0 GB.
scope.sealed_set_disclosure: This is the eighth preregistration scored on 0003's sealed evaluation set (0003 12 times, 0006 for top-k, 0014 10 plus 10 in a smoke, 0015 27 plus smokes, 0016 258 plus smokes, 0017 10 plus smokes, 0018 4); 0020 adds 6 scorings, all of fixed recipes with no selection, and uses the set as the reproduction control and as the reverse reading. The extension corpus, sealed by 0018 as evaluation-only, is scored 6 more times here and is still never fitted on; its five real families are the clause's rows. The fit corpus is fitted on and never scored.
scope.expected_outcome_stated_in_advance: Genuinely uncertain, with the banked arithmetic beside it. 0003's curve on builder content, in distribution, reads 0.0988 at 1000 rows, 0.1415 at 10000 and 0.1965 at 100000; log-interpolating to this run's 26346 rows gives about 0.165 for the incumbent recipe, and 0014's search bought 0.2884 against the incumbent's 0.2395 at 800000 rows. If real content carried the encoder signal the way the builder's generators do, the real-fitted model would read somewhere near that on held-out chunks of the same files - far above the 0.088462 bar. If instead 0018's failure was about real content rather than about the training distribution, the reading stays near chance. We discount the first arithmetic, without a banked number for it, because the fit corpus is a sixth the size of 0003's 100000-row rung in effective per-family depth and is 65 percent one family, and because real files are heterogeneous where each builder family is one generator. The prior is stated as close to even, and either outcome is published at the same size.
scope.flags_stated_in_advance: If builder_matched reaches the bar on the real families and real_model does not, the record says so beside the verdict and does not restate the verdict; if real_model reads below 0018's banked 2450 correct rows, the record says that fitting on real content at this budget did worse than fitting on the builder's eight families at 800000 rows, which is a finding about the budget, not a revision of 0018. Per-family readings are banked against each family's fit-row count, and a family that clears while the mixture does not is reported as such. The reverse reading (each arm on the builder's sealed evaluation set) is banked: a real-fitted model that reads at chance there is not evidence of anything beyond its own training distribution. Iteration counts and whether any arm stopped at its cap are banked.
scope.what_this_does_not_cover: Everything 0018 did not cover, unchanged, plus: this is not a transfer reading (the fit and scored chunks come from the same five blobs); it is not a recipe search on real content; it is not a statement about real content at other carve sizes; and it does not revise 0003, 0014, 0015, 0016, 0017, 0018 or 0019.

ext_chunk_layout.why: 0018 sealed this layout for the same evaluation corpus; it is restated here so the frozen reader can require the scores file's chunk ids to be the sealed ids expanded by their sealed row counts without carrying the corpus itself

protocol.reference_source: artifacts/pivot/deflate_curve.json rungs[n_units=100000].accuracy, the rung preregistration 0016 reproduced in this environment (artifacts/pivot/fdc_4096.json incumbent_100k_refit_top1)

fit_corpus.selection_rule: every whole 32768-byte chunk of each pinned blob that 0018's sealed selection (n_per_family 300, seed 20260909, recomputed here from tools/pivot/corpus_ext.py) does not use, in blob order, minus every chunk whose bytes hash to a sealed chunk's or to an earlier fit chunk's; no seed of its own

incumbent.why: 0003's incumbent verbatim (run_study.py make_model 'hgb', run_carve.py's explicit last-10% validation split); every other parameter at the sklearn 1.9.0 default

logistic_l3.why: standardised inputs with C 1.0: the single most standard fix for an lbfgs logistic on 1108 unscaled hand-engineered columns

model.why: capacity plus regularisation plus a lower rate together: 800000 rows x 26 classes supports bigger trees than 63 leaves, and the deep-tree baseline gained 0.1459 -> 0.1812 from depth 8 to 16 at 4096

repro_block.rule: the sealed pool's first 100000 rows in its sealed order, which is 0003's rung of that size

matched_block.rule: the sealed pool's first 26346 rows, the fit corpus's row count

fit_block.rule: every row of the fit corpus, in the np.random.default_rng(20260825) permutation of range(n_rows), so the recipes' last-10% validation split is a random tenth rather than one family

sealed_hashes.note: canonical-JSON sha256 (sort_keys, separators (',', ':')) of scope.protocol, of scope.recipes and of each recipe; the reader carries the same literals and every banked record's params_sha256 must equal its recipe's, which equals 0014's banked params_sha256 for the same recipe

scope_parameters_sealed.passes_if: preregistration == '0020-realfit-4096'; smoke is False; stage == 'run'; the corpus block equals the sealed constants; the banked protocol equals the sealed PROTOCOL key by key and hashes to PROTOCOL_SHA256; the banked recipes equal the sealed three and hash to RECIPES_SHA256.

corpora_sealed.passes_if: The banked fit_corpus and ext_corpus blocks equal the sealed ones: array sha256/shape/dtype for X, y, g and fam, row and chunk counts overall and per family, the family orders; the scores file's ext_fam bytes hash to the sealed extension fam array and its ext_chunk_ids (int32 little-endian) to the sealed g array.

nothing_scored_was_fitted.passes_if: The runner's measured counts fit_chunks_shared_with_ext, fit_chunks_shared_with_builder, fit_source_chunks_shared_with_ext, fit_rows_identical_to_a_scored_row, repro_rows_identical_to_a_scored_row and matched_rows_identical_to_a_scored_row are all 0, and the eval/pool hashes are 0003's sealed ones.

complete_one_scoring_per_fit.passes_if: complete is True with run_finished_utc set; each of the six named records has status 'fit', the sealed recipe (id, family, params, params hash, scaled, val), the sealed seed and rows, an integer iteration count, a fingerprint the reader recomputes from the sealed literals, exactly one 'completed' ledger event carrying that fingerprint preceded by a 'started' event with it, completions in the sealed order, and a per-example vector of n_eval + n_ext entries in {0, 1} whose sha256 the record carries; each record's readings equal the reader's recomputation from the vector.

reproduces_the_rung.passes_if: |repro's accuracy on the sealed evaluation set - 0.1965| <= 0.005; the runner files NOT RUN otherwise, before the arms that matter.

null_control.passes_if: The null control (M4 on the fit corpus with its labels permuted) reads <= chance + 0.01 on the extension rows and <= chance + the same on the sealed evaluation rows; it runs before the arms that matter and the runner files NOT RUN otherwise; its labels are a permutation of the fit corpus's labels with the same multiset.

environment.passes_if: Every record's environment equals the sealed one (threads, nice, sklearn, numpy, python) and launch_environment.ok is true.

readings_arithmetic.passes_if: Every banked reading equals the reader's recomputation from the per-example vectors and the sealed family array.

clause.passes_if: real_model's count of correct rows over the 38452 rows of the five real-file families, recounted by the reader from the banked vector, >= 3402 = ceil(38452 x (1/26 + 0.05)) -> REAL_FIT_CLEARS, else REAL_FIT_FAILS.

readings.name: real_model_real_top1
readings.unit: accuracy over the real-family rows, 4 decimals

readings.name: builder_eval_top1 by arm
readings.unit: accuracy on the builder's sealed evaluation set, 4 decimals (the reverse reading)

readings.name: reproduction
readings.unit: accuracy on the sealed evaluation set, 4 decimals

readings.name: validity_failed_clauses
readings.unit: list; must be empty for a non-VOID verdict

arms: REPRO: 0003's incumbent M1 on the pool's first 100000 rows, scored once; must reproduce 0.1965 within 0.005 on the sealed evaluation set or the run is filed NOT RUN.
NULL: M4 on the fit corpus with its labels permuted; both readings must sit at chance + 0.01 or the run is filed NOT RUN.
REAL_MODEL: 0014's searched M4 on the whole fit corpus; its count of correct real-family rows is the clause.
REAL_INCUMBENT and REAL_LOGISTIC: 0003's M1 and 0014's standardised L3 on the same rows; flags at the same bar.
BUILDER_MATCHED: M4 on the pool's first 26346 rows - the same recipe, the same budget, the builder's content; the flag that separates content from volume.

RIVAL EXPLANATION, run as an arm rather than argued: 'the fit corpus is too small to learn anything'. builder_matched fits the same recipe on the same number of builder rows; 0003's curve says that budget reads about 0.165 in distribution on builder content, so if builder_matched reads there and real_model reads at chance, the budget is not the explanation.

RIVAL EXPLANATION, closed by construction: 'the fit rows are the scored rows'. The two corpora share no chunk index, no chunk id and no source-chunk hash, and the runner digests every scored feature row and requires that no fit row, no repro row and no matched row is byte-identical to one; the reader requires those three counts to be 0.
stop_rules: REAL_FIT_FAILS is published at the same size as REAL_FIT_CLEARS would have been, in VERDICT.md, README.md, the outbound documents, DILIGENCE.md and the evidence page, with the builder-matched arm and the per-family readings beside it.
No sealed parameter, recipe, corpus hash, row count or bar changes after the freeze; a defect found afterwards is a new preregistration (0013's and 0019's precedent), never an edit to a frozen file.

A validity or control failure is VOID: the clause is named, nothing is counted in either direction; a VOID run may be resumed from its checkpoints under the identical invocation and is never re-parameterised.

NOT RUN is filed as artifacts/pivot/realfit_4096_not_run.json, and the reader prints it and emits no verdict, when the reproduction rung drifts more than 0.005 (known first, in minutes) or the null control reads above chance + 0.01 on either row set (known second). A refusal exits 3 before any checkpoint exists and is filed by the operator in the engineering log.
Neither outcome revises 0003, 0014, 0015, 0016, 0017, 0018 or 0019; establishes_a_buyer is emitted False on every path.
No number from this run is quoted as a transfer reading: the fit and scored chunks are cut from the same five pinned blobs, and every document that states the verdict states that in the same breath.

thesis.what_a_pass_would_mean: That real files do carry the encoder signal at a 4096-byte carve, and that 0018's failure was about what the model had been shown rather than about what is there to be found. The next question would then be how much real content of a kind is needed, which is a curve, not a verdict.
thesis.what_a_fail_would_mean: That at 26346 rows of this content, this recipe does not reach chance + 0.05 even on held-out chunks of the files it was fitted on. With builder_matched beside it, that separates a budget effect from a content effect; without a pass on either, the honest reading is that the record's headline result rests on content its own builder generates, and the per-family readings say which real kinds come closest.
thesis.what_neither_outcome_means: Neither names a buyer, a customer, a user or a partner. Neither revises any earlier preregistration. Neither is a transfer reading, and neither is a statement about real content at another carve size.

invocation: export OMP_NUM_THREADS=3 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=3 MKL_NUM_THREADS=3; nice -n 10 python3 tools/pivot/run_realfit.py --stage run --prereg-file prereg/0020-realfit-4096.json --cache data/pivot/full_c4096.npz --ext data/pivot/ext_c4096.npz --realfit data/pivot/realfit_c4096.npz --workdir artifacts/pivot/realfit_4096_ckpt --out artifacts/pivot/realfit_4096.json --scores-out artifacts/pivot/realfit_4096_scores.json

smoke.invocation: The invocation above with --smoke added and --workdir, --out and --scores-out pointed under the session scratchpad, and --ext and --realfit pointed at small scratchpad builds; the runner refuses --smoke with an output under artifacts/, with either sealed corpus, or with more than 20000 rows in the repro or matched arms, and refuses a real run with any output outside artifacts/. The reader voids a smoke artifact.
